capabilities: Filter notes with full Dataview queries
Export selected notes to a folder outside the vault
Build output file paths from metadata with JS template expressions and ternaries
Re-point internal links between exported notes and copy referenced assets
Run a user-defined shell command after each export
extras: The README explains why community review flags direct filesystem access, shell execution, and eval; also documents settings export/import between vaults and manual installation steps.
motivation: The author blogs with 11ty and keeps in-progress posts in PARA project folders, so they wanted one source of truth: output files placed by metadata regardless of where the note lives in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to output a subset of notes into a restructured folder layout that static site generators like Hugo or Jekyll can consume.

relations.evidence: Uses the powerful Obsidian Dataview plugin's language to find the files you want to export.
run your custom static site generators on a subset of your notes, like 11ty, Hugo, Jekyll

summary: Exports Dataview-filtered notes to a folder outside the vault using metadata-driven paths, with rewritten links and copied assets.
